descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Still developing，Below is the next section.
Hatch from your egg 🥚 and embark on an unforgettable journey as a baby bird 🐤.
Grow quickly in just 3–6 minutes by eating roasted food 🍗, fruits 🍎, and fish 🐟 to evolve into a fully-feathered flying bird 🕊️.
Explore a breathtaking 3-layer world with glowing sea creatures ✨, flying squid 🦑, and colossal sea monsters 🐠.
Be careful: death turns you into roasted chicken 🍗! Other players can eat you to gain evolution points ⚡🤣.
As a spirit 👻, observe the world without collision until you return to your egg 🥚 to respawn and change your appearance.
Master flight, dodge waterfalls 🌊, ascend through wind currents 🌬️, and reach the ultimate sky island 🏝️ where the Feather Monument celebrates your journey.
Are you ready to soar to the end of the SkySea? 🚀
